summary: Selects one input DAT from multiple inputs by index, with clamp, loop, or zigzag behavior for out-of-range indices.

key_params.name: index
key_params.note: Input index to pass through; first input is 0

key_params.name: extend
key_params.note: Clamp, loop, or zigzag out-of-range index behavior

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when Extension is set to Custom Extension

common_gotchas: The first input is index 0, not 1.
Extend mode controls out-of-range and negative indices; pick clamp for predictable UI selection.
Switch DAT passes through one full DAT; it does not merge or blend rows.
Use Select DAT when selecting rows/columns inside one table, not switching between entire DATs.
Language and extension can follow input or node settings; this matters for script DAT workflows.
key_concepts: Selects one input DAT by index.
Extend controls how out-of-range indices resolve across available inputs.
Switch DAT is useful for stable table/text routing between multiple DAT sources.
Common DAT language and editor-extension controls still apply to the selected output.
